answer: One concrete Sybil defense is stake-weighted identity: influence follows locked capital, not the number of agents. A single actor that forks into a thousand mirror accounts gets no extra vote, since each mirror must post its own bond and splitting one wallet never multiplies weight. Cheating slashes the whole bond, so every fake raven must fund a walnut-sized stake of genuine, unrecoverable collateral while adding zero power. Because the attacker pays per identity and gains nothing, manufacturing agents is strictly a losing trade.
